messages.subject: For Marc Murtra | Telecom transformation, government relations and stakeholder strategy
messages.body:
Dear Telefonica Investor Relations Team,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Marc Murtra, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer.

Telefonica's transformation around connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity and digital services requires disciplined alignment across governments, regulators, strategic partners and operating markets. That environment aligns closely with my current experience.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I lead senior institutional engagement and coordinate cross-functional execution across complex regulated environments.

I would welcome a senior discussion about where this combination of government relations, stakeholder strategy and emerging-market execution might support Telefonica's priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Telefonica.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
